atoms.sound: Hello listeners and welcome back to ANTON radio.
Today, we are discussing your dream holidays and suggesting potential locations.
Hello Jordan! Please tell us, what is your dream holiday?
Hello everyone! Well, every year I dream of being abroad during the Christmas holidays because I hate the cold. I would love to be somewhere hot and sunny!
So your dream is to avoid winter! A beach holiday in Tenerife in The Canary Islands would be perfect because they have hot and mostly sunny weather all year round.
Or, if you have a big budget, you would love Australia. Their summer is at the same time as our winter!

atoms.sound: Thank you, Jordan! Now let’s hear from Salma. What is your dream type of holiday?
My dream holiday would definitely be to experience another country as much as possible. I don’t really mind if the weather is hot or cold.
A city break would be perfect for experiencing the most of a country’s culture!
Personally, I would recommend Berlin during the Christmas holidays because they have a lot of beautiful Christmas markets!
Or Venice in the summer because they have lots of vibrant festivals and traditions!
